header.title: Audience Form Defaults
header.description: The thank-you screen every new audience list starts with. Each campaign can override it while being created or edited — changes here only affect campaigns created from now on.

formAppearance.title: Form Appearance
formAppearance.description: Advanced. Lets each campaign restyle its public response form — layout, colours, wording, and custom HTML/CSS.
formAppearance.toggleLabel: Allow campaigns to restyle their form
formAppearance.toggleHelp: Off: every campaign uses the standard form design. On: a Form Appearance card appears when creating or editing a campaign.
